Monthly hire FAQs

Monthly vehicle hire, answered

1How does monthly vehicle hire work?

You hire the vehicle by the month and extend or return it as you need, with no long lock-in contract. The longer you hire, the better your rate.

2Which vehicles can I hire monthly?

All of them — the iLoad van, the 8-seater iMax, and our iX35, i30 and i40 cars.

3How much is monthly hire?

Vans and the iMax start from $100 per day with monthly discounts; car rates depend on hire length. Call 0435 800 248 for your monthly rate.

4Can I extend my monthly hire?

Yes. Monthly hire is month to month, so you can extend for as long as you need or hand the vehicle back.

5Is there a lock-in contract?

No. Monthly hire is flexible with no long lock-in — that is the point.
